entities.name: Oliver de Termes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olivier de Termes was a knight from the southern French region of Termes, Aude. He was raised as a Cathar but eventually converted to Catholicism in a move that would help restore peace to his homeland following the ravages of the Albigensian Crusade.
